statement: Arbitrary products of all solved effective C1 coherent henselian local families have exact bounded canonical WG coordinates with full square-class groups and ordinary coordinatewise operations
notes: The square class gamma can be infinite-valued. For negative integer multiplicity its inverse equals itself, so no extra positive block is needed; a pure nontrivial square class forces one copy on each side. Exact simultaneous rank/degree minima characterize the image. An explicit exterior absolute-rank recurrence proves closure of bounds. Infinite-family equality/boundedness is not a finite algorithm claim.
